chk_conditions_.name: chk_conditions_
chk_conditions_.value:
(("contract_event_permissions"."topic1_constant" IS NULL) OR ("contract_event_permissions"."topic1_constant" IS NOT NULL AND "contract_event_permissions"."topic1_condition_type" = 'equalTo'))
                    AND
                    (("contract_event_permissions"."topic2_constant" IS NULL) OR ("contract_event_permissions"."topic2_constant" IS NOT NULL AND "contract_event_permissions"."topic2_condition_type" = 'equalTo'))
                    AND
                    (("contract_event_permissions"."topic3_constant" IS NULL) OR ("contract_event_permissions"."topic3_constant" IS NOT NULL AND "contract_event_permissions"."topic3_condition_type" = 'equalTo'))

chk_sessions_owner.name: chk_sessions_owner
chk_sessions_owner.value: "sessions"."user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "sessions"."tenant_id" IS NOT NULL OR "sessions"."service_id" IS NOT NULL
